description: Machine-readable index of deprecated Factory modules with replacement paths and deprecation reasons.

scoringSystemGate.note: Several modules were deprecated for using scoring as gates, violating SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE.md.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: Scoring-based severity assessment replaced by binary drift detection in architecture-drift-detector. Scoring approach violated SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE.md.

replacement.migrationNotes: Replace score calculations with binary drift detection. Drift is either detected (yes) or not (no). No severity weighting.

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P0 — using scoring as gate violates SCORING_SYSTEM_GATE.md and will cause verifier failure.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: Classification system assigning trust scores to evidence replaced by simple boolean nativeGenerated flag. Scoring trust levels proved unreliable and prone to false elevation of summary evidence.

replacement.location: Boolean flag in all machine-generated artifacts
replacement.migrationNotes: Replace all evidence trust scores with nativeGenerated boolean. Evidence is either machine-generated (trusted) or not (requires corroboration from verifier).

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P0 — evidence trust scoring can mask summary-as-evidence violations.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: Original lifecycle tracker used scoring to assess agent health. Replaced by binary state machine in agent-lifecycle-protocol.md and registry-based tracking. Agent health scores were not independently verifiable.

replacement.migrationNotes: Replace agent health scores with binary state machine. Agents are in exactly one state: spawned, in_progress, completed, failed, stale, closed, archived. Use AGENT_REGISTRY.json and AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl for tracking.

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P1 — agent health scores may not reflect actual agent state.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: Original contract engine had hardcoded schema assumptions incompatible with current configurable verifier architecture. Replaced by worker-contract-engine with schema-driven validation.

replacement.migrationNotes: Migrate contract definitions to current JSON schema format. Update contract references in phase specifications. Re-validate all existing contracts.

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P0 — hardcoded schema assumptions may cause false PASS on invalid artifacts.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: DRY23-era integration patterns incompatible with DRY24+ governance requirements. API contracts changed, handoff format changed, verifier expectations changed.

replacement.migrationNotes: Update all integration configurations to DRY24 API contracts. Regenerate integration handoff artifacts. Re-validate all integration points.

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P0 — DRY23 integration contracts will fail DRY24+ verifiers.

deprecatedModules.deprecationReason: Pre-DRY24 integration hub with deprecated routing logic and incompatible handoff formats. Superseded by the DRY24-compliant hub.

replacement.migrationNotes: Remove all old routing configurations. Replace with DRY24-compliant routing. Re-run integration verifiers.

deprecatedModules.riskIfUsed: P0 — old routing logic incompatible with current architecture.

verifierChecks.deprecatedModuleUsage: Verifier checks that active phases do not reference deprecated modules. Any reference to a deprecated module in active work is a P0 verifier failure.
